svg.title: G4 A: free disk space during the run
svg.desc: Free space on the data volume through the twelve host sessions, with the drop left by each ANE host and the release when ANECompilerService exited.
svg.text: Free disk space during G4 A
macOS 27.0 (26A428) · statfs free space sampled by the run observer
Shaded: host sessions (teal ANE, blue GPU). The service kept each ANE host's deleted compile input open.
Minutes from the start of the run
Temporary free-space drops during host sessions; these allocations were not individually traced
One M5 Pro and Qwen3-4B assets. Before restart, each ANE host left 6.8–7.0 GiB held.
After restart: about 14.5 GiB less free space per ANE host; only about half traced to a held input.
Other free-space changes were not individually attributed.
